The share-visualisation cell shared by `ComparisonTable` and `InteractiveTable`.

```jsx
<ShareBar width={38.2} value="38.2%" />
<ShareBar width={11.8} value="11.8%" emphasis="accent" />
<ShareBar width={56} value="38.2%" noTrack />
```

Track mode (default) fills a 70px track by percent — the comparison-table look. `noTrack` makes the bar's pixel length the magnitude — the interactive-table look.
